findings.title: Fraser evidence transferred to excluded mental-health population
findings.location: p.2 Introduction; p.5 section 4 Challenge 3; counterreading p.4 section 4 Challenge 1
findings.check: Source eligibility excludes mental-health presentations; Table 2 tests triage with 15/37 unsafe for ChatGPT 3.5
findings.counterevidence: General emergency-triage caution is supported; target elsewhere identifies emergency-department diagnostic and triage evaluation
findings.impact: Narrows background evidence only; no central framework invalidation
findings.correction: Identify nonmental-health emergency cohort; present crisis transfer as unverified
findings.repair_verification: Evidence attribution narrowing supported; no new clinical performance established

findings.title: Woebot anxiety efficacy exceeds comparative trial result
findings.check: Original trial GAD-7 between-arm P=.581; completers improved across both groups P=.004
findings.counterevidence: Descriptive improvement is supported; no inference that nonsignificance proves no effect
findings.impact: Specific anxiety-efficacy evidence, not whole collaborative-care thesis
findings.correction: Distinguish preliminary depression benefit from anxiety improvement in both arms
findings.repair_verification: Source-based statistical distinction verified; no study reanalysis

scope_clarifications.resolution: Independent two-world witnesses identify neither safety nor action-causing effect from ASA alone; section 6.3 proposes complementary safety checks and RCTs
